title: Erik the Slayer
description: Erik in Rorikstead dreams of becoming an adventurer, but his father Mralki refuses to let him go and cannot afford armor. Convince Mralki to change his mind so Erik can pursue his dream.

base_facts: I want to be an adventurer more than anything.
My father Mralki won't let me leave the farm.
We can't afford to buy armor even if he did let me go.
I work as a farmer for Lemkil in Rorikstead.
I stay at the Frostfruit Inn in the evening.

ERIK_REQUEST: A stranger has agreed to talk to my father about letting me become an adventurer.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My father changed his mind! I'm going to be an adventurer. I'll call myself Erik the Slayer.
I hope you'll come back to Rorikstead soon. Maybe we can swap stories about our adventures over a mug of ale at the inn!
My father and I will be visiting Whiterun soon to get me fitted for iron armor.
I'm ready to follow you as a companion if you'll have me.

base_facts: I am the innkeeper of the Frostfruit Inn in Rorikstead.
My son Erik is all the family I have left.
I worry about Erik and don't want him adventuring.
The farm needs Erik, and we couldn't afford armor anyway.

CONVINCE_MRALKI: I've changed my mind about Erik. He can become an adventurer if he wants.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Erik knows I've changed my mind. He's excited to finally become an adventurer.
We'll be heading to Whiterun soon to get Erik properly fitted for armor.

beats.comment: Erik tells the player about his dream of becoming an adventurer and asks them to talk to his father Mralki.
Player convinces Mralki to let Erik become an adventurer through persuasion, intimidation, or bribery.
Player returns to Erik with the good news that his father has agreed to let him become an adventurer.
